archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Where Winds Meet launches Hutuo Battlefield on November 13: October 28, 2026

entries.headline: Aloft / Conan Exiles Enhanced: Aloft and Conan Exiles Enhanced are coming to PS5 in early 2027
entries.summary: Funcom confirmed that both survival games will launch on PS5 in early 2027. Aloft will also expand with new islands, biomes, and survival systems for version 1.0.
entries.verification: First-party PlayStation Blog post; platform and launch window are explicit.

entries.headline: Where Winds Meet launches its Hutuo Battlefield arc on November 13
entries.summary: The anniversary update adds the climactic Hutuo Battlefield narrative arc, a new region, bosses, and related activities. The PS5 edition continues to support 60fps, PSSR, and ray tracing.
entries.verification: Official PlayStation Blog announcement with a specific release date.

entries.headline: Terrible Lizards developers explain their unsettling dinosaur designs
entries.summary: The team describes how familiar dinosaur anatomy, bodily distortion, and chase pacing shape its first-person horror parkour game, due October 29.

entries.headline: Saros audio team details the sound of Carcosa
entries.summary: Housemarque built the audio identity around eclipse, Yellow King, and corruption motifs, supported by 3D Audio, Dolby Atmos, and DualSense haptics.
entries.verification: First-party developer article on PlayStation Blog.

entries.headline: Destiny Child: Assemble announced for the first half of 2027
entries.summary: Com2uS and TIKITAKA Studio announced a global idle RPG for iOS and Android that carries forward the original world's characters while adding a new story.
entries.verification: Two independent outlets report matching details from the official announcement.

entries.headline: Desktop Mate's Mori Calliope DLC launches October 29
entries.summary: The Steam DLC costs 2,200 yen and includes newly recorded Japanese and English voice lines plus a supervised 3D model.
entries.verification: 4Gamer and Denfaminicogamer report matching date, price, language, and model details.

entries.headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 peaks at 87 across its Metacritic platform snapshots
entries.summary: As of 09:30 on October 28, the reported snapshot showed 86 from 36 PC reviews, 85 from 34 PS5 reviews, and 87 from seven Switch 2 reviews; two Xbox reviews were not enough for an aggregate.
entries.verification: The report provides the precise observation time, platform, sample size, and score. These are bounded snapshots, not final scores.

sourceLabels.label: 電ファミニコゲーマー News

entries.headline: World of Warcraft: Forever targets major updates about every 17 weeks
entries.summary: The principal designer said Blizzard wants to move toward roughly three major updates per year, with some content unlocking between those releases.
entries.verification: Direct IGN interview with the principal designer.

entries.headline: World of Warcraft: Forever may briefly revisit Outland, Northrend, and Pandaria
entries.summary: The team may use shorter trips through familiar locations rather than expansion-length journeys, preserving the classic-era focus.
entries.verification: Direct IGN interview; the locations and scope limits come from the developers.

entries.headline: Discord will let some public server channels appear on the web and in search
entries.summary: Starting in mid-December, eligible servers with at least 1,000 members can opt selected public channels into web access and search indexing. About 32,000 servers are currently discoverable.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON relays Discord's published eligibility and administrator opt-in rules.

entries.headline: Everything receives its first major Steam update in six years
entries.summary: The PC edition was rebuilt on an updated engine and adds a microphone feature that lets players make objects sing. Other platforms were not confirmed.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON reports the developer update with explicit Steam scope.

entries.headline: Hair Removal Salon Simulator leaves early access on November 10
entries.summary: The full Steam release arrives November 10 and includes both ordinary tools and absurd options such as a flamethrower and a black hole.

entries.headline: 007 First Light's Switch 2 physical edition is dated March 18, 2027
entries.summary: The Japanese physical edition will launch on March 18, 2027, with a GoldenEye Suit skin as a revised early-purchase bonus.
entries.verification: 4Gamer reports the publisher's product update with explicit region and format limits.

entries.headline: Phantom Line: Prologue is now available for free
entries.summary: The PC prologue serves as the opening chapter of the co-op horror FPS and supports up to four players investigating anomalies as a special-forces unit.
entries.verification: 4Gamer relays the release, platform, chapter role, and four-player limit.

entries.headline: Blue Archive promises story and translation consistency after its Japanese publishing handoff
entries.summary: Ahead of the January 2027 transfer from Yostar to Nexon, an official Q&A said the team will preserve story and translation consistency and is preparing to continue short-form video and voice content.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON relays the official Q&A with the handoff timing and continuity commitments.

entries.headline: Blue Archive adds a 10-minute Buzzer Beat extension to Total Assault
entries.summary: After the October 28 maintenance, an active battle can continue for up to 10 minutes when the room timer expires; restarting and returning to the lobby are disabled during the extension.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON reports the official maintenance notice with its effective date, time limit, and restrictions.
